shortDescription: The Shangai Composite Index decreased 40 points or 1.01 percent on Wednesday to close at 3940 points.The decline was led by Hengli Petrochemical (-4.23%), Yonghui Superstore (-3.35%) and China Molybdenum (-3.25%).
